why: In every row the third figure is the first figure plus four small circles placed in the four corner spaces. Row 1: + gets four circles; row 2: diamond gets four circles at its corners. Row 3: the capsule cross must get four circles outside in the corners, which is option 2. Options 1, 3 and 4 put the circles inside the capsules.
trick: Find what is added from column 1 to column 3 in the complete rows, then add the same thing.
